title: Auto Shankar
desc: Shankar is an autorickshaw driver belonging to a middle-class family who gets into a conflict with Maya, a money-lender. However, tables turn when she loses her property and they fall in love.

title: Nani Gentleman
desc: Two co-passengers on a plane journey, become friends and share their love stories. One of them is shocked when she learns that the man she is dating resembles the other woman's fiancé.

title: Moorkha
desc: Movie starring Kashinath, Namratha, Bhavya and directed by A N Jayaramaiah.

title: Virupaksha
desc: While the occurrence of a series of mysterious deaths haunt the villagers, a man decides to risk his life and unravel the secret behind them.

title: Ondagona Baa
desc: Raghu comes to his paternal village to attend his grandfather's diamond jubilee function. He finds out that due to his uncle, his family was separated, and tries to fix things.
